note: Snapshot of the 25 default tags and their descriptions (defaultPrompts in background.js ensureInitialized). Keep in sync if the defaults change.

tags.label: Health
tags.description: Identify posts related to health, medicine, doctors, hospitals, fitness, wellness, or nutrition.

tags.label: Jobs
tags.description: Identify posts related to job postings, career opportunities, hiring, recruitment, resumes, or interviews.

tags.label: Politics
tags.description: Identify posts related to government, elections, political parties, public policy, or legislation.

tags.label: Tech/AI
tags.description: Identify posts related to software, technology, programming, developer tools, artificial intelligence, or machine learning.

tags.label: Weather
tags.description: Identify posts related to weather forecasts, storms, climate, temperatures, sunny, rain, or snow.

tags.label: Ad
tags.description: Identify advertisements, sponsored content, products for sale, or promotional codes.

tags.label: News
tags.description: Identify breaking news updates, media reports, journalism, headlines, or press coverage.

tags.label: Entertainment
tags.description: Identify posts related to movies, television, music, concerts, gaming, or celebrity culture.

tags.label: Promotion
tags.description: Identify giveaways, special offers, discounts, brand campaigns, or sales promotions.

tags.label: Personal Opinion
tags.description: Identify personal viewpoints, personal updates, opinions, thoughts, or editorial reflections.

tags.label: Portfolio
tags.description: Identify project showcases, personal portfolios, designs, case studies, or displays of professional work.

tags.label: Product Showcase
tags.description: Identify product launches, demonstrations, features, release highlights, or new tools.

tags.label: Immigration
tags.description: Identify posts related to immigration processes, visas, passports, citizenship, or green cards.

tags.label: Migration
tags.description: Identify posts related to relocation, moving to another region or country, expats, or emigration.

tags.label: Study
tags.description: Identify posts related to academic studies, university, learning resources, college courses, or scholarships.

tags.label: International News
tags.description: Identify news about international events, global affairs, foreign relations, or world news.

tags.label: Sports
tags.description: Identify posts related to athletic sports, games, leagues, matches, players, championships, or coaches.

tags.label: Events
tags.description: Identify posts related to upcoming events, conferences, webinars, meetups, festivals, or workshops.

tags.label: Blog
tags.description: Identify references to blog articles, long-form posts, reading materials, or updates for written sites.

tags.label: Vlog
tags.description: Identify video logs, YouTube clips, vlog updates, or video content updates.

tags.label: Culture
tags.description: Identify posts related to cultural heritage, traditions, societal customs, art, or historical celebrations.

tags.label: NGO
tags.description: Identify posts related to non-governmental organizations, charities, volunteering, non-profits, or donations.

tags.label: Policy
tags.description: Identify posts related to policy changes, company guidelines, compliance rules, or regulatory frameworks.

tags.label: Release
tags.description: Identify software releases, product versions, changelogs, updates, or patch notes.

tags.label: History
tags.description: Identify posts related to historical events, ancient civilizations, timelines, archives, or heritage.
